Dates and durations do not determine eligibility. This is a capped selection, not each creator’s complete publication history.

Recordings and creators by month

Each creator contributes up to their 20 newest public uploads (96 of the 101 creators contribute 20; the other 5 contribute fewer), so the selection is not spread evenly in time. A creator who uploads often reaches 20 within weeks; one who uploads rarely reaches back years. The 12 months from 2025-12 to 2026-11 hold 1,604 of the 1,976 recordings (81%) by an exact day or a window wholly inside them, from 91 of the 101 creators.

456 of the 1,976 recordings (23%) are dated inside the four weeks ending on 2026-11-19, the day the channel listings were read (2026-10-23 to 2026-11-19, UTC): 347 by an exact day and 109 by an estimated window lying wholly inside those weeks. They come from 76 of the 101 creators. Half of the 1,579 exact days fall on or after 2026-08-11.

Exact dayEstimated window inside the monthWindow crossing a month boundary · counted in each month it touches

A creator counts in a month when one of their recordings has an exact day or a whole estimated window there; “up to” adds creators known only from crossing windows. Crossing windows may belong to either month and must not be summed. This panel covers the full selection; the filters below do not change it.
